permission_body: Tirat needs camera access to analyze your teff flour sample.
instr_flat: Place flour on a flat plate
inconclusive_body: The photo wasn't clear enough. Please retake it.
disclaimer: ⚠️ This is a fast screening tool, not a certified lab test.
help_improve_desc: If enabled, saved sample photos and results are shared anonymously for research.
opt_in_alert_body: Copies of your photos and their results will be uploaded when internet is available. No personal information is included.
upload_stub_note: Backend is not wired up yet.
model_missing_body: The AI model file is missing or invalid inside the app.
not_food_body: This doesn't look like pure chili powder. Fill the frame with the powder sample under good lighting and retake.
not_food_teff_body: This doesn't look like teff flour. Fill the frame with the flour sample under good lighting and retake.
not_food_texture_body: The image appears to be a blank or uniform surface. Please capture a close-up of the actual flour or powder sample.
not_food_blur_body: Photo is blurry or out of focus. Hold phone steady and retake.
instr_hold_flat: Hold phone flat (90°) directly above powder
instr_fill_box: Fill box with powder only (no sack or basket edges)
redchili_disclaimer: Calibrated for pure ground red chili pepper. Not for finished multi-spice Berbere blends (containing fenugreek, korarima, garlic).
teff_demo_badge: Teff mode is a demo — the real teff model is still in training. Red chili mode is fully active.
